# Math & Equations

Quarto supports beautiful math rendering using LaTeX syntax. Here are some examples:

## Inline Math

The famous equation $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ is known as Euler's identity.

## Display Math

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$

## System of Equations

$$
\begin{cases}
  x + y = 1 \\
  x - y = 2
\end{cases}
$$

## Quadratic Formula

$$
x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
$$

You can add more math content using standard LaTeX notation.
